decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the dry dock is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8.30am  to 5.30pm  on Mondays to Friday and 8.30am  to 12. noon  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The  hereby permitted  for a roof on the dry dock shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the dry dock roof against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the proposed construction of a new roof over the dry dock to enclose the existing mess room, office and working area would be acceptable having due regard for the effect of enclosing the dry dock and the neutral impact on the surrounding area of the island and its ecology.  The proposal also has a neutral impact on the character of the Conservation Area.  On balance the development is in accordance with the UDP Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development) ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) ENVW 1.1 (Design in the Thames Policy Area), ENVW 1.3 (Important views and structures in the Thames Policy Area), ENVW 1.5 (Nature Conservation in the Thames Policy Area) and ENVW 2.5 (Residential Moorings).  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Construction of a new roof to enclose existing mess room, office and working area.
